title: MondayMotivator 10 March: How to really annoy people.
html:
A positive attitude may not solve all your problems, but it will annoy enough people to make it worth the effort. Herm Albright

Have you ever noticed how much it annoys people when you have a positive attitude?

You will be asked questions like: Why are you always smiling? Are you always this positive?

And they will be thinking: 'What's their secret' or 'they must be hiding something'.

What if you're just a positive person? What if going to work is something you really enjoy because you're passionate about what you do.

Being positive makes you stand out of the crowd. Standing out scares the crap out of most people but not you. You want to be the best and are striving for it, go for it. Be the best!
